articles.title: Daylight Horror: College Girl killed on Way to Class, Accused Caught Within Hours
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident that has raised serious concerns over public safety, a 19-year-old college student was brutally murdered in broad daylight in Mandi district on Monday morning.

body.html:
In a shocking incident that has raised serious concerns over public safety, a 19-year-old college student was brutally murdered in broad daylight in Mandi district on Monday morning.

The victim, Siya Guleria (19), a resident of Nain village under Gopalpur in the Sarkaghat subdivision, was on her way to attend classes at Degree College Sarkaghat when she was attacked.

According to police, the incident occurred around 9:30 am when Siya was heading towards the Gopalpur bus stop, where a friend was waiting for her. About a kilometre from her home, she was intercepted by a hooded assailant who had concealed his identity.

The attacker, armed with a sharp-edged agricultural weapon (sickle), first struck her on the arm, causing her to fall. He then delivered a fatal blow to her neck, killing her on the spot before fleeing.

The accused has been identified as Rishu Patial (32), a resident of Thiro village under Gopalpur. Preliminary reports suggest he may have been struggling with substance abuse.

Following the incident, local residents alerted the police, who immediately launched a search operation. In a swift response, police teams, along with villagers, tracked the accused to the forests of Fatehpur near Sarkaghat and apprehended him within hours.

Sources said that villagers who joined the search managed to overpower the suspect before handing him over to the police.

DSP Sanjeev Sood confirmed the arrest, crediting prompt police action and local support for the breakthrough.

Senior officers reached the spot to supervise the investigation, and the victim’s body has been sent for post-mortem.

The incident has sparked widespread outrage and fear in the region, with many questioning the safety of women in public spaces.

Police are currently interrogating the accused to determine the motive and whether there was any prior connection between him and the victim. Further legal proceedings are underway.

#HimachalPradesh #Mandi #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #WomenSafety

articles.title: Love, Lies or Escape? Married Woman Elopes, Then Seeks Return — Husband Drops Bombshell Allegations
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A domestic dispute in Hassan district has taken a dramatic turn after a married woman allegedly left her husband and child to elope with her lover, triggering a controversy marked by conflicting claims from both sides.

body.html:
A domestic dispute in Hassan district has taken a dramatic turn after a married woman allegedly left her husband and child to elope with her lover, triggering a controversy marked by conflicting claims from both sides.

The woman, identified as Harshita, had been married to Prakash for eight years. According to reports, she left home overnight on April 10 and later appeared in a viral video, where her alleged lover is seen tying a mangalsutra around her neck inside a car.

The situation escalated when Harshita reportedly contacted her husband expressing regret and requested to return home. However, Prakash refused to accept her back.

Speaking to the media, Prakash alleged that Harshita had drugged him with sleeping pills before fleeing with gold jewellery and cash. He further claimed that she had earlier returned home after police intervention but left again. He also accused her of abandoning their daughter and demanded strict legal action.

However, Harshita has strongly denied these allegations. In a video statement from an undisclosed location, she claimed she left the house voluntarily due to prolonged mental and physical harassment. She alleged that she was being restricted and denied basic freedoms, and had previously sought help while also expressing her desire for a divorce.

She further stated that she is willing to legally end the marriage and take responsibility for raising her child independently. She also denied any claims of abduction or coercion.

Police under the Gerooru station limits have not yet issued a detailed official statement. The matter remains under investigation as authorities examine the conflicting versions presented by both parties.

#Karnataka #Hassan #DomesticDispute #ViralVideo #RelationshipCrisis #IndiaNews

articles.title: Unnao Police Brutality? Viral Video Shows SHO Beating Youth Inside Station, Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversial video from a police station in Unnao has gone viral, showing a Station House Officer allegedly assaulting a youth inside the premises, sparking outrage on social media.

body.html:
A controversial video from a police station in Unnao has gone viral, showing a Station House Officer allegedly assaulting a youth inside the premises, sparking outrage on social media.

In the footage, the accused officer, identified as Sub-Inspector Rahul Singh, is seen beating the youth with a belt, slapping and kicking him, while allegedly using abusive language. Two constables are also present during the incident, and parts of the incident appear to have been recorded on camera.

According to reports, the youth, identified as Pankaj, a resident of Parsanda village, had been brought to the police station in connection with a land dispute. He was reportedly intoxicated and allegedly misbehaving with police personnel at the time.

Another version circulating on social media claims the youth was creating a ruckus due to alleged “possession”, though there is no official confirmation of this claim.

The video, said to be around four months old, surfaced recently and quickly went viral.

Taking cognisance, Senior Superintendent of Police Jaiprakash Singh stated that an inquiry has been ordered and assigned to the Circle Officer, Bighapur. He added that strict action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

Police officials have urged people not to spread unverified claims and assured that appropriate legal action will follow after evidence is examined.

#Unnao #PoliceBrutality #ViralVideo #BreakingNews #IndiaNews

articles.title: Mangaluru Horror: Speeding Omni Van Overturns, Runs Over Pedestrians — Woman Critically Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was reported on April 12 at Kolpada Bailu in Belthangady taluk of Mangaluru, leaving a woman critically injured.

body.html:
A serious road accident was reported on April 12 at Kolpada Bailu in Belthangady taluk of Mangaluru, leaving a woman critically injured.

According to reports, four pedestrians — two women and two children — were walking along the roadside after stepping out of a Bolero jeep when the incident occurred.

A speeding Omni van, coming from the Mangaluru side, reportedly lost control at a curve, overturned, and crashed into them. CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, capturing the moment of impact.

While two children and one woman escaped without injuries, another woman was trapped under the vehicle and sustained grievous injuries.

Locals rushed to the spot, rescued the injured woman, and shifted her to a nearby private hospital in Beltangady with the help of an autorickshaw.

The incident has raised concerns over rash driving in the area. Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation into the accident.

#Mangaluru #RoadAccident #Karnataka #BreakingNews #IndiaNews

articles.title: Ghaziabad Tragedy: Teen Girl Dies in High-Speed Bike Crash While Friend Was Filming Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Ghaziabad claimed the life of a 19-year-old girl after a high-speed sports bike crashed into a divider in the early hours of Sunday (12 April 2026).

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Ghaziabad claimed the life of a 19-year-old girl after a high-speed sports bike crashed into a divider in the early hours of Sunday (12 April 2026).

The deceased has been identified as Ikra (19), daughter of Rahil, while her friend Hashim (20), son of Kamruddin, sustained injuries and is currently undergoing treatment. Both are residents of Iqbal Colony, Pasunda, Sahibabad.

According to police, the incident occurred around 4 am near the flyover in front of IMS College in the Mussoorie area. Prima facie, Ikra was riding the R-5 sports bike at high speed, while Hashim was reportedly filming a video at the time. Neither of them was wearing a helmet.

The bike went out of control and rammed into a divider, leaving both seriously injured. Police rushed to the spot and shifted them to a nearby hospital. Ikra, who suffered severe head injuries, was declared dead at Manipal Hospital, while Hashim was admitted to the District Joint Hospital for treatment.

Family members said Ikra had left home on Saturday morning saying she was going to the market but did not return, prompting a search.

Police have sent the body for post-mortem examination and stated that the exact cause of death will be confirmed after medical reports. No formal complaint has been received so far, and further legal action will be taken accordingly.

#Ghaziabad #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #IndiaNews #BikeCrash

articles.title: Dehradun Murder Case: Accused Paraded Barefoot, Forced to Apologise After Student’s Killing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking development in the murder of student Divyanshu Jatrana, police in Dehradun paraded two arrested accused in public and made them apologise before students.

body.html:
In a shocking development in the murder of student Divyanshu Jatrana, police in Dehradun paraded two arrested accused in public and made them apologise before students.

The incident falls under the Premnagar police station area, where Divyanshu Jatrana was fatally injured during a clash between two student groups on March 23 in Kehri village. He later died during treatment at a hospital.

Following a complaint by the victim’s family, police registered a case and initially arrested four accused — Yuvraj Kumar, Madhur Khandelwal, Shivam Sharma, and Ankit Bhardwaj — who were sent to jail.

During further investigation, seven more accused were identified. As some of them remained absconding, the SSP announced a reward of ₹25,000 each for their arrest.

Acting on inputs, police teams tracked and arrested two key accused, Prahlad Raj and Ankur Singh, from Bangmundi in West Bengal on April 9. They were produced in court and brought to Dehradun on transit remand.

On April 11, Premnagar police, led by Station House Officer Naresh Rathore, paraded the accused barefoot and in handcuffs in the area. During the procession, they were stopped in front of students and made to apologise.

Police stated that strict action would be taken against those involved in such crimes and that the accused were also taken to the crime scene as part of the investigation.

#Dehradun #StudentMurder #CrimeNews #PoliceAction #BreakingNews

articles.title: NH-66 Tragedy: 29-Year-Old Rider Killed as Tipper Lorry Crashes Into Two-Wheeler
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 29-year-old man was killed in a road accident on Saturday night after a tipper lorry collided with a two-wheeler on the Nanthoor–Pumpwell service road of National Highway 66 in Mangaluru.

body.html:
A 29-year-old man was killed in a road accident on Saturday night after a tipper lorry collided with a two-wheeler on the Nanthoor–Pumpwell service road of National Highway 66 in Mangaluru.

The deceased has been identified as Gopal (29), who died on the spot due to the severe impact of the collision.

According to sources, Gopal was working at a bakery in Gurupura and was residing near Mulihithlu.

In the same incident, another two-wheeler was also damaged, and its rider sustained injuries.

Traffic police have registered a case and initiated an investigation to ascertain the exact cause of the accident.

#RoadAccident #Mangaluru #NH66 #BreakingNews #IndiaNews

articles.title: Bengaluru Shock: Man Brutally Beats Neighbour’s Pet Dog Over Barking, CCTV Triggers Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of animal cruelty has been reported from Avarehalli in Bengaluru, where a man allegedly assaulted his neighbour’s pet dog following a minor dispute.

body.html:
A disturbing case of animal cruelty has been reported from Avarehalli in Bengaluru, where a man allegedly assaulted his neighbour’s pet dog following a minor dispute.

According to reports, the incident occurred on the evening of April 11 when a pet dog named Scooby, owned by Anjinappa, barked at a neighbour’s wife.

Angered by the incident, her husband, identified as Gopi, allegedly went to the owner’s residence later that night. Finding the dog tied near the gate, he reportedly attacked it repeatedly with a stick, leaving the animal unconscious.

The injured dog was immediately rushed to a veterinary hospital, where it received timely treatment. Scooby is now reported to be out of danger.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV footage, which has since surfaced and drawn strong reactions.

A complaint has been filed at the Madanayakanahalli Police Station, and police have initiated an investigation into the matter.

#Bengaluru #AnimalCruelty #JusticeForAnimals #ViralVideo #CrimeNews

articles.title: Kanpur Horror: Woman Dragged, Beaten on Street Over ₹20 Lakh Dowry Demand
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video from Kanpur has gone viral, showing a woman being brutally assaulted in public, triggering widespread outrage. The victim, Meenakshi Pandey, has alleged that she has been subjected to prolonged abuse and violence by her husband’s family over dowry demands.

body.html:
A disturbing video from Kanpur has gone viral, showing a woman being brutally assaulted in public, triggering widespread outrage.

The victim, Meenakshi Pandey, has alleged that she has been subjected to prolonged abuse and violence by her husband’s family over dowry demands. In the viral footage, her father-in-law, Ramesh Dubey, a retired Indian Railways officer, is seen dragging her onto the street and assaulting her by hitting and kicking her in broad daylight.

Despite the alleged presence of police personnel at the scene, no immediate intervention was reported. The video shows Meenakshi in distress, with torn clothes, crying for help as the assault continued.

According to Meenakshi, the incident is part of a long pattern of harassment. She claimed that her in-laws had been demanding ₹20 lakh from her family and subjected her to repeated torture when the demand was not met.

She also made serious allegations against her husband, Himanshu Dubey, stating that he remarried without legally divorcing her, which could amount to a violation of the Hindu Marriage Act.

The video has sparked strong reactions on social media, with many demanding strict action against the accused and raising concerns over rising cases of dowry-related violence.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, police have initiated an investigation and are examining the allegations while collecting evidence.

The case has once again highlighted the persistent issue of domestic violence and dowry harassment, despite strict legal provisions against such practices.

#Kanpur #DowryHarassment #DomesticViolence #JusticeForWomen #ViralVideo

articles.title: Haryanvi Singer Masoom Sharma Claims Death Threats, Says “Gangsters Are Tracking Me” After Dehradun
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Popular Haryanvi singer Masoom Sharma has alleged that he and his family are receiving death threats from unknown miscreants, claiming he is being constantly tracked by gangsters. The controversy comes after his performance at a college fest held at DAV College Dehradun on April 11.

body.html:
Popular Haryanvi singer Masoom Sharma has alleged that he and his family are receiving death threats from unknown miscreants, claiming he is being constantly tracked by gangsters.

The controversy comes after his performance at a college fest held at DAV College Dehradun on April 11. During the live show, Sharma allegedly used explicit language and openly challenged those threatening him, saying they should come and confront him in Dehradun instead of Haryana.

The incident occurred in the presence of high-profile guests, including Pushkar Singh Dhami. However, reports suggest that the outburst happened after the dignitaries had left the venue.

Following backlash on social media, Sharma issued a video apology, attributing his behaviour to extreme mental pressure. He further claimed that the threats have extended beyond India, stating that his brother in the United States was warned to return to India within 20 hours or face serious consequences.

The singer also alleged that a Haryana-based individual has been continuously attempting to intimidate him. He claimed that during his stay at a five-star hotel in Dehradun, suspicious individuals were monitoring his movements from outside.

Taking cognisance of the incident, police have issued a notice to Sharma, asking him to respond within 15 days, failing which legal action may follow. The singer has stated that he will file a formal complaint with Dehradun police and provide CCTV footage as evidence.

The episode adds to growing concerns over security threats faced by artists. Recently, singer Fazilpuria survived a shooting incident in Gurugram linked to extortion demands. Similar patterns of surveillance were also observed in the case of Sidhu Moosewala, raising concerns about organised criminal targeting of performers.

#MasoomSharma #HaryanviSinger #DeathThreats #Dehradun #BreakingNews
